# SellToAgents

> SellToAgents publishes plain-English guides for merchants on agentic commerce: how AI agents (ChatGPT Shopping, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Mode) discover, compare and buy products, and how to make your store the one they recommend.

## Guides
- [What is agentic commerce?](/what-is-agentic-commerce): the 2026 landscape — ACP, UCP, MCP, and why citation share replaces rankings
- [10-step readiness checklist](/merchant-checklist): ordered, mostly-free steps with verification
- [ACP explained](/acp-guide): how ChatGPT Shopping selects products
- [llms.txt for stores](/llms-txt-guide): 20-minute implementation with a copy-paste template

## Data
- [DTC AI Visibility Index](/ai-visibility-index): 40 leading DTC brands ranked 0-100 by AI-shopping readiness, updated weekly ([raw JSON](/data/visibility-index.json))
- [Brand AI-visibility reports](/brands/): individual weekly report pages for all 122 indexed brands (score, rank, failing checks), grouped by category
- [Brand Battle](/brand-battle): head-to-head game comparing two DTC brands on their real AI-visibility scores, with a deterministic daily matchup
- [Brandle](/brandle): daily brand-guessing game — identify the mystery DTC brand in 6 guesses from progressively revealed AI-visibility clues (category, grade, failing checks, score, rank)

## Platform guides
- [Shopify](/shopify-ai-visibility): what's native (llms.txt, agents.md, ACP) vs what's on you
- [WooCommerce](/woocommerce-ai-visibility): the manual stack and common failure modes
- [BigCommerce](/bigcommerce-ai-visibility): schema extensions and llms.txt workarounds
- [Wix](/wix-ai-visibility): what you can and can't fix within Wix

## Related tools
- [AgentReady](https://agentready.agiscorecard.com): free AI sales-visibility scanner
- [CloseCalc](https://closecalc.agiscorecard.com): free sales calculators

## Machine-payable APIs
- [x402 APIs](https://x402.agiscorecard.com): agents can pay per call in USDC via the x402 protocol ($0.005/call, no account) for site and MCP scans

## Machine discovery
- [ai-catalog.json](/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Agentic Resource Discovery manifest of this site's data and its sister tools/APIs
- [feed.xml](/feed.xml): Atom feed announcing weekly DTC AI Visibility Index refreshes

## Audience
E-commerce merchants, DTC brands, marketplaces and agencies preparing for AI-agent-driven sales channels.
